title: RNA sequencing of GPRC5C-Knockdown (GPRC5C-KD) and control LT-HSCs from human bone marrow
description: The transcriptome of shRenilla and shGPRC5C in long term hematopoietic stem cells (LT-HSC) from human bone marrow was assessed by RNAseq.

samples.title: Ren_Ctlr_1
samples.description: Protocols: CD34+ bone marrow cells (StemCell Technology) were FACS sorted for LT-HSC (CD34+CD38-CD45RA-CD90+CD49f+) and prestimulated in culture for 24h. Cells were transduced with lentivirus of two different shGPR and shRenilla. The selection of the shRNA depended on GFP and puromycin. After 48h post-transduction, puromycin selection was performed for 48h. Positively transduced cells were marked by GFP and sorted using the FACS Aria III (Becton Dickinson) at the MPI FACS facility, Freiburg, Germany. The following sort parameters were used: 100 um nozzle with approximately 1,000 evt/s. 200 GFP+ cells were collected into ice-cold RNA lysis buffer (ARCTURUS PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit (Life Technologies, Invitrogen)) and stored at -80C until further usage. Total RNA isolation was performed from the indicated populations using ARCTURUS PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit (Life Technologies, Invitrogen) according to the manufacturers instructions. DNAse treatment was performed using RNAse-free DNAse Set (Qiagen). Total RNA was used as starting material for cDNA-libraries preparation using the Low Input RNA: cDNA Synthesis, Amplification and Library Generation (NEB #E6420). 14 PCR cycles were used for cDNA amplification and 10 cycles for PCR enrichment.
